title: The Case of Cheryl Christensen
description:
In 2020 police arrived to Cheryl Christensen's door, as her family were worried. Inside a horrifying discovery would be made, and the Cheryl would be arrested for what she did to her son, Shannon Lloyd. Before justice could be delivered, four years later, she was found in her burnt out home.

I'm also curious where she got the idea that red spraypaint could represent Jesus' blood, & that she should use the magic/supernatural method for protection. Mike may be aware of some of the folklore for protection from the faeries since he's Irish, but the 2 most common methods for an ordinary person would be burning Sage, which most people have at least heard of, or using salt as a magical barrier, tho that wouldn't work on the reflective surfaces, & for the doors & windows, it would just be placed at the bottom of them. But, that's not really a part of this story that matter, I just have a personal interest in that stuff.

I really don't understand how Shannon had so much money but none if it was being used for his care & wellbeing. That level of money should have been paying for home health aids, transportation to all his appts, any kind of changes to the home to help him, like a bed rack that would allow him to get in & out of bed on his own, as well as changes to the toilet & bath/shower, if not just providing for a better home for them both.

I know that many people are pretty ignorant about our Social Security/Disability system, but if he had no money at all, he should be getting an SSD income to help, plus Medicare & Medicaid; the latter would pay for any transportation to appts he might need, plus home visits.
